workflow.title: Workflow Options
workflow.description: Enable at least one analysis subworkflow. The run will fail if none is selected.

snv.title: Somatic small variants (SNV/indel)
snv.description: Call somatic small variants with ClairS, or with ClairS-TO when no normal sample is given.

sv.title: Somatic structural variants (SV)
sv.description: Call somatic structural variants with Severus.

mod.title: Modified bases
mod.description: Aggregate modified-base calls to bedMethyl with modkit. Requires input BAMs with MM/ML tags.

bam_tumor.title: Tumor BAM (single file)
bam_tumor.description: BAM or uBAM file for the tumor sample. This pipeline analyzes one BAM per sample; merge multi-BAM samples before ingest.

bam_normal.title: Normal BAM (single file)
bam_normal.description: BAM or uBAM file for the matched normal sample. Leave blank to run in tumor-only mode, which skips differential methylation and switches small-variant calling to ClairS-TO.

ref.title: Reference FASTA
ref.description: Reference genome FASTA. Annotation requires hg19/hg38; the default structural variant panel of normals is hg38 only.

sample_name.title: Sample name
sample_name.description: Sample name to be displayed in workflow outputs.

bed.title: Target regions BED
bed.description: Optional BED file of regions to process for variant calling.

tr_bed.title: Simple repeat BED
tr_bed.description: Optional BED file of simple repeat regions passed to Severus. A bundled hg19/hg38 file is selected automatically when this is left blank.

pon_file.title: Structural variant panel of normals
pon_file.description: Optional Severus panel-of-normals TSV of expected germline SVs. A 1000 Genomes panel is used automatically for hg38 when this is left blank.

annotation.title: SnpEff annotation
annotation.description: Annotate variant calls with SnpEff/ClinVar (hg19/hg38 references only).

include_all_ctgs.title: Include all contigs
include_all_ctgs.description: Call variants on all sequences in the reference; otherwise variants are only called on chr{1..22,X,Y,MT}.

igv.title: IGV output
igv.description: Emit configuration for the EPI2ME IGV visualizer.

tumor_min_coverage.title: Minimum tumor coverage
tumor_min_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage of the tumor BAM required to run analysis. Set to 0 to skip the check.

normal_min_coverage.title: Minimum normal coverage
normal_min_coverage.description: Minimum read coverage of the normal BAM required to run analysis. Set to 0 to skip the check.

depth_intervals.title: Depth intervals bedGraph
depth_intervals.description: Output a bedGraph file with entries for each genomic interval featuring homogeneous depth.

snv_options.title: Small Variant Calling Options
snv_options.description: Only used when the small variant subworkflow is enabled.

override_basecaller_cfg.title: Override basecaller configuration
override_basecaller_cfg.description: Basecall model used to select the small-variant calling model. Normally auto-detected from the BAM header; set only when the header lacks (or mixes) basecall-model annotations. Indel calling is only performed for dna_r10 models.

germline.title: Germline calling
germline.description: Call germline variants with Clair3 and use them to phase the tumor. Disabling this greatly speeds up execution but removes the germline VCFs. Ignored in tumor-only mode.

fast_mode.title: Fast germline calling
fast_mode.description: Relax Clair3 variant calling parameters to speed up germline calling. No germline VCFs are emitted.

phase_normal.title: Phase the normal sample
phase_normal.description: Phase and haplotag the normal sample in addition to the tumor. Requires a normal BAM.

liquid_tumor.title: Liquid tumor
liquid_tumor.description: Use ClairS presets and models tuned for liquid tumors. No liquid-tumor presets exist for tumor-only mode.

skip_haplotype_filter.title: Skip haplotype filtering
skip_haplotype_filter.description: Skip haplotype filtering of the called variants.

normal_vcf.title: Pre-computed normal VCF
normal_vcf.description: Germline VCF for the normal sample, skipping germline calling for that sample. A bgzipped VCF must be accompanied by its .tbi index.

hybrid_mode_vcf.title: Hybrid mode VCF
hybrid_mode_vcf.description: Combine de novo calling with genotyping at the positions in this VCF. Cannot be combined with a genotyping mode VCF.

genotyping_mode_vcf.title: Genotyping mode VCF
genotyping_mode_vcf.description: Call variants only at the sites in this VCF. Cannot be combined with a hybrid mode VCF.

sv_options.title: Structural Variant Calling Options
sv_options.description: Only used when the SV subworkflow is enabled.

min_sv_length.title: Minimum SV length
min_sv_length.description: Minimum size in bp of the structural variants called by Severus.

severus_args.title: Extra Severus arguments
severus_args.description: Additional command-line arguments passed to Severus. These fully override the options set by the workflow.

mod_options.title: Modified Base Calling Options
mod_options.description: Only used when the modified-bases subworkflow is enabled.

diff_mod.title: Differential modification analysis
diff_mod.description: Detect differentially modified loci and regions with DSS. Requires a normal BAM, and is memory intensive.

force_strand.title: Strand-aware modification calls
force_strand.description: Require modkit to call strand-aware modifications.

modkit_args.title: Extra modkit arguments
modkit_args.description: Additional command-line options passed to modkit. These fully override the options set by the workflow.

ubam_map_threads.title: uBAM mapping threads
ubam_map_threads.description: Max threads for aligning reads from uBAM (limited by executor cpus).

ubam_sort_threads.title: uBAM sort threads
ubam_sort_threads.description: Max threads for sorting and indexing aligned reads from uBAM.

ubam_bam2fq_threads.title: uBAM bam2fq threads
ubam_bam2fq_threads.description: Max threads for uncompressing uBAM and generating FASTQ for alignment.

haplotype_filter_threads.title: Haplotype filter threads
haplotype_filter_threads.description: Max threads for the haplotype filtering stage of the small variant subworkflow.

severus_threads.title: Severus threads
severus_threads.description: Total threads used by Severus (minimum of 4, limited by executor cpus).

modkit_threads.title: modkit threads
modkit_threads.description: Total threads used in modkit modified-base calling.

dss_threads.title: DSS threads
dss_threads.description: Total threads used in the DSS differential modification analysis. DSS reserves roughly 19 GB of memory per thread.
